title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Position Overview:
We are in search of a meticulous and organized Data Entry Specialist to join our client, a leading third-party logistics (3PL) provider. The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure accurate and timely entry of data related to shipments, inventory, and other logistical information into our systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities:

• Enter and update data related to shipments, inventory levels, and other logistical information into the company's database system with precision and efficiency.

• Verify the accuracy of data entries by cross-referencing them with source documents and resolve any discrepancies or errors in a timely manner.

• Collaborate closely with warehouse personnel, transportation teams, and other departments to obtain necessary information and ensure data consistency and accuracy.

• Assist in maintaining and organizing electronic and physical records to facilitate easy access and retrieval of information.

• Conduct regular audits and quality checks to identify and rectify any inconsistencies or inaccuracies in the database.

• Generate reports and summaries as required, providing insights and analysis on key performance metrics and trends.

• Adhere to company policies, procedures, and industry regulations governing data management and confidentiality.

• Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation to streamline data entry processes and enhance efficiency.

• Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data entry and logistics to continuously improve performance.

Working conditions:

• Working schedule: Monday - Friday 7 am - 4 pm PST with an hour lunch

• A supportive team

• Competitive Salary in USD

• Remote mode of work

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• English courses

• Equipment provided

Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent; additional education or certification in data entry, logistics, or a related field is preferred.

• Proven experience in data entry or a similar role, preferably in a 3PL or logistics environment.

• Proficiency in data entry software and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, with the ability to manage large volumes of data efficiently.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment, demonstrating strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• Familiarity with logistics terminology, inventory management systems, and transportation processes is advantageous.

•
Build and maintain internal tooling used to run and score evaluations

Collaborate with policy and engineering partners to translate eval findings into safeguard improvements

Experience building or running evaluations, benchmarks, or test suites for software or ML systems, including delivering results on short, fixed timelines

Hands-on cybersecurity experience (e.g., CTF participation, vulnerability research, exploit development, or security research)

•
Proficiency in Python

Strong ability to communicate evaluation results with multiple cross-functional stakeholders or potential policy stakeholders

Deep offensive-security or security-research experience, including experience building AI security benchmarks

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Supabase's Partnerships function is scaling fast - spanning Technology Partners, Solution Partners, Startups, and Cloud Partnerships. We're looking for a Partner Operations & Systems Lead to own the operational and technical backbone that lets this team move quickly and make decisions with good data.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll design the systems, processes, and reporting that the whole partnerships org runs on - and, increasingly, you'll build the internal tools yourself. Supabase is investing heavily in AI-assisted development to move faster than a traditional ops build cycle allows, and this role is expected to be a leading example of that inside Partnerships.

You'll report directly to the Head of Partnerships and sit alongside our regional and functional leads as a peer, with the mandate to build and enforce operational rigor across all teams.

Beyond the infrastructure, we want someone who helps shape where Partnerships places its bets - not just the system that reports on them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Systems & Data Infrastructure

- Own the partner tech stack end-to-end - CRM partner objects, attribution tooling, and partner-facing portals.

- Design and maintain partner attribution models and the dashboards leadership uses to evaluate performance.

- Ensure data hygiene and consistency across partner records, deals, and touchpoints spanning all sub-functions.

Process & Program Management

- Design and run partner onboarding, tiering, and certification programs.

- Own the RFC / DRI decision-making framework for the partnerships team, including how it's used and refined over time.

- Run deal-registration and "quarterback" account-ownership processes that keep internal teams aligned on partner-sourced deals.

- Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and enablement materials that let the team scale without you in every meeting.

Internal Tooling & Automation

- Build internal automations that remove manual ops work - e.g., auto-generated partner performance reports, HubSpot-to-Slack syncs, or deal-conflict alerts - using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code.

- Prototype and ship lightweight internal apps and dashboards (partner health scorecards, RFC trackers, cross-tool syncs) without waiting on a shared data engineering backlog.

- Act as technical owner for partnerships' internal tools: write the spec, build it, test it, ship it, and maintain it.

- Know where the line is between a quick internal script and something that needs to be handed to Data/Engineering for production hardening - and manage that handoff cleanly.

Reporting & Analytics

- Produce recurring performance reporting on partner-attributed revenue and pipeline influence.

- Own the metrics and KPI framework the partnerships team is measured against.

- Support QBRs and board-level reporting on partnership performance.

Strategic Contribution

- Contribute to partner segmentation, tiering, and prioritization strategy - bringing data and operational reality to bear on where the team should invest.

- Challenge existing assumptions in the partner motion (which tiers, which incentive structures, which sub-functions get resourced) using evidence from the systems you own.

- Partner with the Head of Partnerships on strategic planning cycles - translating operational signal into recommendations, not just dashboards.

- Own execution of agreed strategic direction: once a call is made, drive the operational and cross-functional work to make it real.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Serve as the connective tissue between Partnerships, Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Finance.

- Ensure partner agreement terms are correctly reflected in systems and reporting.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

These champions are the main decision makers in whether Harvey succeeds at an account, and Admin is where they turn their investment into measurable return. Building that is one of the highest-leverage jobs at Harvey, and you'll shape the team around it. You'll own the system every team builds from and the AI tooling that changes what a designer can produce.

You'll report to the VP Design as a foundational member of the Design leadership team, with portfolio-wide impact on how our product, team, and culture scale. You'll set the operating bar for how we work, and lay foundations for the product that hold for years.

title: Senior Paid Search Manager (£42K - £50K DOE)
description:
We're the team iGaming operators turn to when growth matters most - and we're growing fast ourselves. At Receptional , you'll find colleagues who are bright, ambitious, and genuinely supportive. Specialists who do their best work together, sharing ideas, moving fast, and holding themselves to a high bar.

Whether you're starting out or stepping up, you'll get genuine investment in your development through our internal academy, real variety in your work, and a direct impact on some of the biggest names in the industry. Competitive benefits, flexible working, and a team that has your back.

We were named Marketing Services Supplier of the Year at the EGR B2B Awards 2026, and Best Medium Agency to Work For at the Company Culture Awards 2025 - recognition for the work we do and the place we've built to do it.

Paid search in iGaming is some of the most technically demanding PPC work in digital marketing. The budgets are significant, the compliance requirements are strict, and clients expect a senior point of contact who can think strategically as well as get into the weeds of an account. As a Senior Paid Search Manager at Receptional you'll be owning Google Ads strategy and execution across a portfolio of major iGaming clients - running campaigns, managing client relationships, and developing up to two direct reports. You'll work closely with the Head of Paid Search with genuine autonomy across your accounts and a clear path upward for the right person. What We're Looking For

You'll need to be a confident practitioner and a credible leader - someone who can run complex paid search accounts autonomously while developing the people around them at the same time. Senior paid search in iGaming demands commercial sharpness, deep platform expertise, and the ability to present strategy to clients who know their numbers and will push back. You'll also be managing direct reports, so clear direction, honest feedback, and genuine investment in people development comes with the territory.

Essential:

• 3+ years' paid search experience, ideally agency-side, with proven results managing Google Ads at scale

• Strong campaign creation and optimisation experience - you know what good looks like and you can prove it

• Google Ads certified - current and maintained

• Strong client relationship management skills - you present with confidence and handle difficult conversations without escalating everything

• Solid campaign planning capabilities - budgeting, forecasting, and performance management across multiple accounts simultaneously

• Experience managing or mentoring direct reports - you've developed people, not just worked alongside them

• Commercially minded and analytically strong - you work with data confidently and translate it into clear strategic recommendations

• Comfortable using AI tooling to improve campaign efficiency and workflow automation

Desirable:

• iGaming or regulated-sector experience - we'll get you up to speed if not

• Microsoft Ads certified or actively working towards it

• Experience liaising directly with Google or Microsoft platform partners

• Contribution to new business proposals, audits, or award entries

• Experience training others internally on paid search best practices

How you'll be measured

Campaign performance against agreed client KPIs, accuracy of budget and spend management, quality and timeliness of client reporting, direct report development progress, and contribution to new business activity. What You'll Be Doing

This is a senior paid search role with real leadership responsibility. You'll be owning Google Ads strategy and execution across a portfolio of large iGaming clients - managing campaigns, running client relationships, and developing the team beneath you. The budgets are significant, the clients are commercially demanding, and you'll be expected to bring strategic thinking to every account you touch. You'll work closely with the Head of Paid Media while operating with genuine autonomy

title: Sr. RF Front-End Engineer — Phased Array Antenna & RF Front-End Electronics
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

As a Senior Antenna Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design, simulation, and validation of advanced antenna systems for E-Space’s LEO satellite constellation and ground infrastructure. You are expected to independently design antennas using full-wave electromagnetic simulation tools, with HFSS as a primary design environment, and drive designs from concept through hardware validation.
 
On-site in California or Texas. Some travel between sites may be required.

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core

• Innovative thinking is encouraged

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Role Purpose
The Legal Administrative Assistant provides high-level administrative support to multiple lawyers in an Australian legal practice from an offshore location in the Philippines. The role focuses on administrative support rather than paralegal work, ensuring court deadlines, diaries, and stakeholder communications are managed efficiently.
This is a highly administrative, deadline-driven role requiring exceptional organisation, attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to perform under pressure.
Key Responsibilities
Administrative & File Management

• Open and maintain client files in the firms legal practice management system (Smokeball), ensuring files are complete, accurate, and consistently organised

• Prepare case agreements and manage administrative documentation

• Manage a high volume of police-related matters, including documents, videos, relevant information, handling correspondence, and scheduling appointments for clients

• Prepare and manage electronic folders for barristers, including creation of shared folders or secure drop boxes

• Ensure all documentation is correctly named, filed, and easily accessible

• Support approximately 200 clients while ensuring compliance with legal requirements

Diary & Deadline Management (Critical Function)

• Manage a shared diary for multiple lawyers

• Accurately diaries all court dates, conferences, hearings, and key deadlines

• Send timely reminders to lawyers ahead of conferences and court events to allow adequate preparation

• Monitor upcoming deadlines and proactively flag conflicts or missing information

Stakeholder Communication

• Communicate professionally with clients, police, courts, barristers, and other external stakeholders

• Send court dates, funding reminders, and other critical updates to clients

• Draft and send correspondence with a high level of discretion and attention to tone

• Handle sensitive matters and client communications professionally

General Administrative Support

• Assist lawyers with document preparation, correspondence, and matter coordination

• Support improvements to administrative processes and workflows where appropriate

• Work efficiently in back-end systems to maximise workflow and software utility

Key Skills & Experience
Essential

• Proven experience in a legal administrative or secretarial role

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and strict deadlines

• Keen attention to detail and accuracy, particularly in diary and file management

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Confidence working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment

• Ability to take initiative and work independently once trained

Preferred

• Experience supporting Australian lawyers or familiarity with the Australian legal system

• Experience in criminal law or litigation-based practices

• Prior experience using Smokeball or similar legal practice management systems

• Experience managing multiple lawyers diaries simultaneously

Personal Attributes
· Highly organised and methodical
· Proactive and solutions-focused
· Calm and reliable under pressure

• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy

• Comfortable reminding or prompting lawyers when deadlines or information are at risk

• Able to manage high volume administrative tasks confidently and independently

Performance Indicators

• Accuracy of diary management and zero missed court deadlines

• Quality and organisation of client files

• Responsiveness and professionalism in stakeholder communication

• Ability to anticipate administrative needs and reduce lawyer workload

Work Environment
This is an offshore role based in the Philippines supporting an Australian legal practice. The successful candidate must be comfortable managing competing priorities, adapting quickly to change, and maintaining high standards under time constraints.

description:
Sanctions & Fraud Transformation Consultant / Senior Consultant

Location: Edinburgh / Glasgow (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Transform the future of financial crime risk with Capco

The Role

Capco is seeking experienced Consultants and Senior Consultants to join our growing Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) capability. You'll support clients in delivering meaningful change across sanctions and fraud risk, balancing regulatory compliance with innovation. This is an opportunity to deliver impactful transformation while contributing to a collaborative, people-first consultancy. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to improve insight, delivery efficiency, and decision-making while applying appropriate human judgement and responsible AI practices.

What You'll Do

• Lead or support advisory and transformation initiatives across financial crime, sanctions, and fraud, leveraging AI-enabled analysis and automation where appropriate to improve delivery and client outcomes.

• Deliver operating model redesigns, technology enablement, and cost optimisation across the three lines of defence, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency through AI-enabled workflows and intelligent automation.

• Support clients managing regulatory reviews, remediation programmes, and operational backlogs while ensuring appropriate governance and oversight of AI-assisted outputs.

• Benchmark and assess controls, identify gaps, and design practical solutions that strengthen risk management using data-driven insights and responsible AI techniques where appropriate.

• Contribute to proposition development, client offerings, business development, and thought leadership across the financial crime and fraud domain.

What We're Looking For

• Experience delivering financial crime transformation within financial services or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of sanctions, fraud prevention, investigations, and the wider financial crime landscape.

• Familiarity with financial crime technology, operational processes, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that improve operational effectiveness.

• Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with experience using approved AI tools to enhance analysis, productivity, and delivery.

• A collaborative approach and commitment to responsible AI adoption within regulated financial services environments.

Bonus Points For

• Programme or Project Management or Business Analysis experience within financial crime transformation.

• Experience designing and implementing target operating models and financial crime control frameworks.

• Experience delivering automation, AI-enabled analytics, or advanced technology solutions across AML, sanctions, or fraud transformation.

• Previous consulting experience within financial services.

• For senior candidates, experience leading teams, developing propositions, supporting business development, and contributing to client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development.

• Help shape the future of financial crime transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across the financial services industry.

Benefits

• Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

• Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.

• Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.

• Family Care: Eight complimentary backup care sessions

title: vIOP Clinical Quality Supervisor
description:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced mental health clinician and leader with a passion for clinical care, quality, supervision, and management to serve as a clinical quality supervisor for our Pediatric virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP), an accelerated, comprehensive care experience that helps young people ages 7 to 25 feel better quickly from the comfort of home. The pediatric vIOP is a critical service for acute patients who need more than traditional, once-a-week therapy. This program is a critical component of our full-spectrum of care services. It not only helps to avoid re-hospitalization, but its availability within our services ensures these members have direct access to our core coaching, therapy, and psychiatry services once they are stabilized. 
As a vIOP Clinical Quality Supervisor you will spend half the time delivering direct client care and half the time providing management oversight and clinical supervision to vIOP Associate Social Worker (ASW) therapists.
Direct client care: You will provide time-limited, evidence-based treatment via telehealth. You’ll conduct individual, family, and group skills training sessions, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll conduct psych urgent care individual sessions as needed, which consists of risk and safety assessments and developing stabilization plans. An important note: Clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care-an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience. 
Clinical supervision and management: You will help train, manage, and supervise a team of ASW therapists utilizing CBT, DBT, ERP and other evidence-based practices to support vIOP clients through our innovative video therapy platform. This includes reviewing and providing feedback on clinical quality metrics and consulting on clinical cases. You will also assist with quality improvement initiatives including specialty consultations, provider training, and quality assurance reviews. 
Regularly: Our vIOP team members enjoy connecting with peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one clinical consultation, multidisciplinary team meetings, and robust training to enhance your clinical and supervision skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options-from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care-you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
This role is a great fit if you have experience supporting pediatric and young adult clients with mood and anxiety disorders in a high acuity (IOP, PHP, residential) setting using evidence-based and culturally responsive practices, as well as supervising and managing registered ASW’s. 
This role reports to our vIOP Clinical Quality Manager.

title: Product Director
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

Product Leadership at Nu
At Nubank, we want to deliver the best possible products to our customers. This aspiration guides our product, engineering, and design decisions from the moment we conceive of an idea to the first version of a product we put in a user’s hands to the endless iterations we make after that. Product development at Nubank is fundamentally about impact, and this is where we start when we evaluate new ideas. We want to have meaningful, long-term value for our customers by providing products that are truly empowering and life-improving. Or, as one of our company values says: “We want our customers to love us fanatically.”

We're always looking for exceptional product leaders to reinvent the future of financial services. We do not look for opportunities that are small or use cases where good solutions already exist. We look for big problems that cause people (and companies) enormous amounts of frustration and pain. One of our other company values emphasizes this point: “We are hungry and challenge the status quo.” In financial services, this boldness often means targeting the complexity that is endemic to financial products.

What you'd be taking on
Product leaders at Nubank are in the intersection of massive scale and insurgent mindset. Nubank products have massive scale across the globe, reaching more than 135 million people across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia. It means our product leaders operate at a level of complexity that is hard to find anywhere else. Furthermore, the road ahead is incredibly more complex and exciting than what we have achieved so far, as we expand into new countries, business lines and customers' lives. As a product leader, you own the vision, the strategy, the trade-offs, the launch, and the numbers afterward. You're a fit first and foremost if you're fanatical about our customers and you want to challenge the status quo.

You should apply if

- You set the vision, not just the roadmap. You can define where a business unit or building block is going two-plus years out, and defend it with customer insight, business logic and technical depth in equal measure.

- You've built the teams that build the products. You've grown and coached multiple product teams - not one - and you've hired and levelled up product managers who went on to do the same. That track record tells us more than a number of years ever could.

- You have genuine product approach. You stay close to the data, the customer and the market.

- You build with AI. You've used AI to change how your teams discover, prototype and ship - and you have a clear, practical view of where it belongs in the product itself and where it doesn't.

- You're hands-on at a senior level. Our most senior product people still get into the details of the product and the market.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence-enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

title: Sales Specialist
QA Chapter Lead
description:
QA Chapter Lead

Location

Europe

Reports to

Head of Engineering Platform

Squad embedding

Embedded and active in one squad - not a standalone QA manager

Chapter scope

Platform: 4 Squads (4-6 embedded QA engineers)

About Watu

Watu is a fintech company operating across Africa and Latin America, providing device financing and financial services to customers historically excluded from the formal financial system. We finance motorcycles, smartphones and other productive assets through a technology-first, data-driven approach - enabling customers to own income-generating assets and build credit histories.
Our platform supports millions of customer journeys across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Ivory Coast, Ghana, and beyond, with continued expansion into LATAM.
The Role
The QA Chapter Lead is a senior QA engineer who carries two roles simultaneously. First, you are an embedded QA engineer in one of the squads - attending ceremonies, writing automated tests, defining acceptance criteria, and owning the Definition of Done for your squad. Second, you are the QA Chapter Lead for your engineering function, responsible for QA standards, tooling, automation frameworks, and test strategy across all squads in the function.
You report to the Head of Engineering - not to a Tech Lead. This reporting line is intentional: it gives you the organisational standing to influence QA practice across squads you are not embedded in, and it ensures the Head of Engineering actively drives QA strategy rather than delegating it entirely to individual Tech Leads.
This is not a QA manager role. There is no QA team to manage. There is a chapter of QA engineers across squads, and you are their technical lead and standards-setter - not their line manager. The QA Guild (monthly cross-chapter meeting with the counterpart Chapter Lead from the other engineering function) is your primary mechanism for cross-function consistency.
What You Will Own
As embedded QA engineer in your squad

• Attend all squad ceremonies - sprint planning, daily standup, sprint review, retrospective. QA is in the room from the start, not brought in at the end.

• Define acceptance criteria with the Product Owner before each sprint. Stories without clear acceptance criteria do not enter the sprint.

• Write and maintain automated test suites for your squad's domain - unit, integration, E2E as appropriate. Test coverage is your responsibility.

• Own the squad's Definition of Done quality gate - nothing ships without passing the criteria you have defined and maintained.

As QA Chapter Lead across your function

• Define and maintain QA standards for the function: test pyramid structure, automation tooling, naming conventions, coverage thresholds, and CI gate configuration.

• Onboard new QA engineers into the chapter - they join a squad, but they join your standards. Define the onboarding process and the baseline expectations.

• Run the monthly QA Guild with the counterpart Chapter Lead from the other engineering function. Alignment on tooling, shared frameworks, and Definition of Done consistency across the full engineering organization.

• Own the automation framework selection and evolution - evaluate new tooling, deprecate old, and maintain documentation that any QA engineer can follow.

• Report to the Head of Engineering on QA chapter health: coverage trends, flaky test rates, automation backlog, and any systemic quality issues.

Who You Are
Essential

• 5+ years of software QA experience with at least 2 years in a Lead QA role where you drove test strategy across more than one team.

• Strong automation engineering skills - you write test code to a production standard. Your test suites are maintainable, readable, and run reliably in CI.

• Experience with API testing at depth: REST, contract testing, integration test design. Most of Watu 's QA surface area is backend and API-level.

• Experience defining and maintaining QA standards in an Agile squad environment - not as a gatekeepe

With $19.75M raised, they're seeing 40% month-over-month growth and building a repeatable sales motion at a critical inflection point

title: Structural Analyst, Payloads
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team is building Thunder - an autonomous attack rotorcraft built to fight alongside crewed combat aviation to deliver overwhelming mass effects deep beyond the front lines. The team in London builds the Mission System and the autonomy that makes aircraft like Thunder work.

Autonomy is only as good as the link that carries it. Thunder is a compact airframe with weapons, sensors and radios competing for the same antenna real estate, flying low and in formation, in a spectrum that is actively contested. That is the problem you would own.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a Structural Analyst for the Thunder team. In this role, you will own the structural analysis, load path validation, and interface integrity for critical mission systems, specialized sensors, and operational payloads. You will serve as the primary structural bridge between our internal mission systems team and our partner’s airframe engineering group, ensuring seamless physical integration and envelope compliance. Your day-to-day focus will include finite element modeling (FEM), static and dynamic load evaluation, and vibration analysis to meet rigorous flight safety and airworthiness standards. This is a high-impact opportunity to directly shape how cutting-edge autonomy and payload capabilities merge with a clean-sheet aircraft platform.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Perform static and dynamic structural analyses of composites and metallics using first principles and appropriate analysis methods (hand calculations, spreadsheets, scripts, detailed FEA

• Develop and own FEM creation and organization at the global and subsystem level

• Collaborate with hardware engineers to drive proper designs based on analytical results

• Document analysis methodology and results in technical reports for internal teams and external stakeholders

• Conduct and support validation testing, including instrumentation requirements, load requirements, data collection, and model correlation

• Participate in flight testing including setting Do No Exceed values, monitoring loads, and dispositioning inspection findings

• Ensure designs meet customer requirements, industry standards, and safety regulations

• Stay current with advancements in analysis techniques, materials technology, and industry standards

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or higher degree in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures

• Deep understanding of statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, and materials properties

• Structural testing experience (static, buckling, cyclic) including sensor selection, data acquisition, and data post-processing

• Proficiency in FEA software (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN) solution sequences for linear and non-linear static and buckling analyses

• Experience with CAD tools (NX, Solidworks)

• Proficiency in Matlab or Python (or equivalent) for developing analytical models, data acquisition, and automation

• Highly motivated, self-starting, and able to perform duties autonomously without supervision

• Very organized and willing to establish scope and requirements for ill- defined problems

• Must be eligible to obtain an US security clearance

title: Technischer Softwareberater im Homeoffice

• Du möchtest von zu Hause arbeiten und dadurch Privatleben und Beruf besser unter einen Hut bekommen?

• Du suchst ein Unternehmen in dem langfristig gedacht und gehandelt wird?

• Dir liegen pragmatische Lösungen und schnelle Entscheidungen?

• Dir ist Fairness, Wertschätzung, Vertrauen und Verlässlichkeit wichtig?

Wenn ja, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Wie sieht deine tägliche Arbeit aus?
Als Softwareberater bist Du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, unserem Vertrieb und unserer Produktentwicklung. Du begleitest Kunden von der ersten Produktpräsentation bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung unserer Software und stehst ihnen auch danach fachlich & technisch beratend zur Seite.

• Durchführung von Produktpräsentationen.

• Analyse und Qualifizierung von Kundenanforderungen sowie technische Beratung im Vertriebsprozess.

• Erstellung von Angeboten, Leistungsbeschreibungen und technischen Lösungskonzepten.

• Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen in technische Anforderungen für unsere Produktentwicklung.

• Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Kundenprojekten über alle Projektphasen hinweg - vom Kick-off bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live unserer Software.

• Projektbegleitung in der Einführungsphase beim Kunden vor Ort

• Durchführung von kundenspezifischen Workshops, Schulungen und Onboardings - bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden.

• Erstellung von Projekt- und Prozessdokumentationen.

• Begleitung und Koordination der Pilotierung neuer Produktfunktionalitäten gemeinsam mit ausgewählten Kunden.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Entwicklung, Produktmanagement und Vertrieb.

Von wo aus kannst Du arbeiten?
Fast alle unsere Mitarbeiter arbeiten zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice. Über moderne Technologie wie z.B. Microsoft Teams vernetzen wir uns dabei digital. Deshalb bieten wir Dir an, primär von Deinem Home-Office aus zu arbeiten. Durch regelmäßige Meetings an unserem Firmensitz kommt aber auch der persönliche Kontakt zu Deinen neuen Kollegen nicht zu kurz. • Erfahrung in der Beratung, Einführung und Betreuung von Softwarelösungen, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld oder mit vergleichbarer Unternehmenssoftware.

• Erfahrung in der Analyse von Kundenanforderungen und Geschäftsprozessen.

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge und Anforderungen schnell zu erfassen.

• Kommunikations- und Präsentationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte verständlich für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen aufzubereiten.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement-Tools und Methoden.

• Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

• Hohe Kundenorientierung und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden.
